content:
Field Name
Field Description
BootLoaderUnlocked
Contains information on bootloader status.
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation
IsEcho
Indicates if the same event was sent before.
KeyStoreTrusted
Contains information on whether cryptographic keys are hardware backed.
VerifiedBootState
Provides the device’s current boot state. Values:
VERIFIED (0)
SELF_VERIFIED (1)
UNVERIFIED (2)
FAILED (3)
